chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Al-Ḥasan ibn Al-Jahm, from Al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, who said:
Al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام said: “No body becomes weak regarding that for which the intention has grown strong.”

key_terms.النِّيَّةُ: intention or inward resolve that drives action
key_terms.بَدَنٌ: the physical body or bodily strength

ai.seo_question: How does strong intention affect a person’s ability to act?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that strong niyyah (intention) gives a person strength to carry through difficult actions. It highlights the moral and spiritual power of inner resolve in shaping outward effort and endurance.
